bio_en: Hrach Pehrizian was born in Van in 1885 and educated at the Yeramian school. As a young man he was an active Hnchak, then left party life, trained at the police school in Kars after the 1908 constitution and served for some years as a police official in Van, where he protected many compatriots. In 1914 he left with his cousin H. Yeramian for the Caucasus, Constantinople and Izmir, and from 1918 to August 1921 was secretary and manager of the United Orphan Relief society in Egypt. He joined the ARF in 1917, led its victory in the 1922 Alexandria community elections, and died of a lung illness in Alexandria early in 1925.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Community figure rather than a fighter.
